The army that reaches Berlin has paid for the ground twice over — a war fought closer to the historical ███████ of holding rigid lines regardless of the arithmetic, at the cost this campaign keeps returning to. The industrial evacuation was subordinated to front supply in 1941 — easing that autumn's crisis at a cost in Urals production capacity that every later year of this campaign quietly pays for. The tank armies waited for the three fronts to close together and entered ██████ on May 11, two days later than they did in the real war. The Vistula was crossed to relieve the Warsaw Uprising rather than held at — the ██████ history's Stavka did not take, run here against the fresh SS armor that was actually waiting at the city's approaches. No branch of this campaign reaches a different destination — only the timing and the price were ever in Soviet hands.One Year LaterVictory arrived close to the historical May 8, 1945, and the year that follows tracks the historical one closely: the Red Army's occupation zone, the █████████ of a new political order installed behind it, and a wartime alliance already audibly disagreeing about what Europe's map is supposed to mean now that the shooting has stopped.
